answer_1.quote: In this paper, we systematically assess the performance of two modes of spoken language translation for idiom translation: (1) direct speech-to-text translation, and (2) cascaded speech translation whereby the audio is first transcribed by a ASR system followed by a text-based machine translation.

answer_2.quote: To assess model performance, we employed both automatic and manual evaluation methods. For the automatic evaluation of translation quality, we utilize the COMET metric...

answer_4.quote: To supplement COMET evaluations, two human annotators evaluated a random sample of 50 translations from each language-dataset-model combination using the annotation scheme in Table 1...
answer_4.guideline: The annotation scheme includes categories ranging from Correct to Empty/Ellipsis, explicitly judging if figurative meaning was maintained.
